title:
A type that represents the absolute coloring strategy configuration of a {@link UiSdlHeatMapColorFieldSetting}.
The component recognizes the highest/lowest values and automatically assigns colors based on distance
to the high/low value. Here, if most values are close to the high value, the map would be unbalanced with color for the high end of the spectrum.
name: UiSdlHeatMapAbsoluteColorSetting
